label: V6.4.136 - DESKTOP WORKSPACE
notes: Desktop workspace redesign. My Flight now fills the desktop workspace beside the fixed sidebar instead of behaving like an oversized centered modal, uses responsive auto-fit flight cards, compact desktop tools and a stable navigation pair: one fixed previous-page arrow plus MENU to the authenticated Home. The old CÔNG VIỆC reload action and back-button create/remove flicker are removed. Mobile layout and V6.4.135 form-open performance path remain unchanged.
message: V6.4.136: thiết kế lại giao diện PC; mũi tên quay trang trước ổn định, MENU về menu chính, mobile giữ nguyên.
